CitationExcerpt.description: A UTF-8-safe prefix of a cited span; no search query or matching word is involved.

end.description: Byte offset just past the excerpt in the cited field.

start.description: Byte offset of the excerpt in the cited field.

ClaimGroup.description:
Claims that say the same thing once merged Persons are taken as one (knowledge §35). There is
no representative claim: each member keeps its own id, status and revision.

revision.description: The hash of the sorted (member id, revision) pairs. Never a claim id.

support_count.description: Number of live justifications, independent of the explanation page limit.

fresh_until.description: Last complete check plus the freshness rule.

last_checked.description: When the source was last checked completely (found or empty).

reason.description: Why the latest attempt couldn't look, kept next to the last successful check.

registered.description:
Whether the source is in the config in this scope. A removed source, or one whose
scope changed, keeps the coverage its stored windows give, with `registered: false`.

windows.description: The newest windows the source was looked at, newest first (all of them when asked for). Empty in search answers.

windows_total.description:
How many windows the source has been looked at over: every window, listed or not.
Search answers (per source and per hit) carry it too, with `windows` left empty.

CoverageWindow.description: One window `[from, to)` a run looked at, with what it found.

state.description: A window records what a run saw, never "never looked" or "unknown".

Entity.description: An entity: one exact canonical identifier, with its type.

ExtractionPair.description: The extraction state of one (source, scope) pair.

extractor_version.description: The installed version; `None` when the extractor is not installed.

ExtractionReport.description: One extractor run over a source's pending evidence. Its counts are of claims.

ExtractionStatus.description: Where an extractor stands for one (source, scope) pair at its installed version.

oneOf.description: No installed extractor provides the bound id.
Evidence, or the whole replay for a new version, is not yet extracted.
The latest run at this version failed; reads serve the last good projection.
Every observation of the pair has been extracted at this version.

IntentCitation.description: The owner intent a justification rests on: its id, when it was issued and by whom.

IntentKind.description: The kinds this slice enables. Slice 7 adds claim and claim-set kinds to the same table.

IntentStatus.description: Where an intent stands once every later intent is read.

oneOf.description: It contributes what its kind says.
A cannot-link that an explicit link or merge of its pair cleared.
A name a newer name of the same Person replaced.

IntentView.description: An intent as `rastro identity` shows it.

payload.description: The versioned operation data, as stored.

status_by.description: The intent that gave it its status (the undo, the clearing link or merge, the newer name).

targets.description: The versioned, tagged target structure, as stored.

IssuerContext.description:
Who issued an intent, through which surface, seeing which scopes (none listed: every scope).
Audit data, not lasting authorization.

JustificationView.description: A complete derivation. The limit counts bundles, never individual required spans.

current.description: False for a historical justification that no longer supports the current claim.

intent.description: The owner intent behind a justification of kind `owner_intent`.

KnownInterval.description: When evidence established and replaced current support for a claim.

Match.description: Where in the span a hit matched: a window of at most [`EXCERPT_BYTES`] bytes.

clipped_after.description: Text of the span follows the excerpt.

clipped_before.description: Text of the span precedes the excerpt.

end.description: Byte offset just past the excerpt, in the same origin as the hit's `end`.

located.description: False when the matching word couldn't be found; the excerpt then starts at the span's start.

start.description: Byte offset of the excerpt in the quote's span, in the same origin as the hit's `start`.

text.description: The excerpt, as stored; never rewritten.

Object.description: What a claim says about its subject.

PersonRef.description: A Person, by its entity id and canonical identifier.

RebuildPair.description:
One (source, scope) pair of a claims rebuild: how its extractor ended. A pair that is not
`current` never started, and its stored output was carried over.

counts.description: Claim counts of the pair's run, as the run log records them.

extraction.description: The run of the extractor the source is bound to, after ingestion.

SearchResult.description: One hit of a search: the citation, why it matched, and the whole quote only on request.

original.description: The full original, only when the search asked for `full` and the source keeps originals.

quote.description: The whole span; only when the search asked for `full`.

ValidTime.description: Item update times do not establish when individual fields changed in the world.

Window.description: Half-open window `[from, to)` of RFC 3339 timestamps.

description: Every operation's input and result, and the envelope `--json` prints. Generated from the operation catalog; do not edit.

result.description: Matches, plus the coverage of every source searched.
result.title: SearchResponse

pairs.description: Every (source, scope) pair the rebuild visited.

groups.description: Equivalent claims under a merge, grouped. A group counts once toward `limit`.

result.description: What `identity me` and `identity person create` did.

created.description: False when the Person already existed and nothing was recorded.

intents.description: The intents accepted, in acceptance order.
